Current manual work: People can complete full intake paperwork before learning that OCD cannot serve their location.
Proposed n8n coordination: Check the approved service area before full intake and route uncertain locations to an owned review task.
Retained human step: Confirm actual capacity and exceptional locations.
Acceptance: Covered, uncertain and unconfigured postcodes produce the correct recorded outcome.
Dependencies / gate: Approve the list and routing rules; retain uncertainty rather than rejecting negotiable areas.

Current manual work: Website, email, telephone and coordinator referrals require separate monitoring and manual collection.
Proposed n8n coordination: Collect authorized forms and emails into one queue. Let staff log telephone, voicemail and unsupported channel references, retaining original sources and preventing duplicate cases.
Retained human step: Log unsupported phone/voicemail sources and resolve uncertain identities.
Acceptance: Repeated or changed sources create the correct case/version without duplicate enquiries.
Dependencies / gate: Test actual mailbox notifications, expired cursors, folder scope, attachments and source replay.

Current manual work: Several administrators can inspect the same message while another request remains unanswered or lacks an owner.
Proposed n8n coordination: Assign owners, deadlines and response status. Suggest category and urgency, and retrieve candidate booking or invoice references for review.
Retained human step: Confirm urgency, sensitive routing and candidate invoice/booking identity.
Acceptance: Each request has one accountable next action; missed deadlines remain visible and owned.
Dependencies / gate: Add approved assignment/escalation rules and notification outcomes; current classification is a suggestion.

Current manual work: Incomplete forms, unclear dates and missing supporting documents create repeated clarification work.
Proposed n8n coordination: Check agreed required fields and documents. Prepare clarification requests, assign follow-up and retain received answers beside the original source.
Retained human step: Resolve ambiguous dates, verify authenticity and provide missing answers.
Acceptance: Incomplete, unsupported and ambiguous sources are flagged without invented values.
Dependencies / gate: Approve required fields and test representative forms. F applies to checking, not obtaining truthful answers.

Current manual work: Staff copy information from forms and scans into participant records and must check for existing people.
Proposed n8n coordination: Extract draft fields with source evidence, present duplicate candidates, prepare exact approved changes and verify the native result. Preserve the original file and record links.
Retained human step: Approve identity, consent, field values and separate service/accounting readiness.
Acceptance: The source and exact approved fields link to one verified native identity; replay creates no duplicate.
Dependencies / gate: Validate native intake feature fit, actual forms, mapped fields and account writes; preserve prospects until activation is approved.

Current manual work: Worker information is re-entered and separate qualifications, access and payroll setup require chasing.
Proposed n8n coordination: Prepare reviewed worker fields and track outstanding screening, documents, access and the existing payroll handoff in one onboarding case.
Retained human step: HR verifies qualifications, employment decisions and payroll readiness.
Acceptance: Approved basic staff data is verified and incomplete HR/payroll steps prevent readiness claims.
Dependencies / gate: Test role/invitation behaviour and readiness checks. A recorded onboarding status does not itself establish sign-in permissions.

Pain point / process: Client stages and agreed service details
Current manual work: Staff search prospect and active lists and recover agreed hours or changes from emails and notes.
Proposed n8n coordination: Track enquiry, consultation and active stages with transition checks. Link approved service hours and changes to their evidence, effective dates and affected bookings.
Retained human step: Approve activation, service hours, funding implications and effective dates.
Acceptance: Only an approved transition changes the native stage; hours retain their authoritative source.
Dependencies / gate: Extend the mapping whitelist for explicit stage transitions; define which native record owns agreed hours rather than creating a second editable agreement.

Current manual work: Staff repeatedly write similar messages, sometimes omitting the person, service time, outcome or next action.
Proposed n8n coordination: Prepare messages from approved templates and check recipient, person, date, time, confirmed outcome and next action before approval.
Retained human step: Approve sensitive wording and send through the agreed channel.
Acceptance: A complete reviewed message reaches an owned handoff; no task is labelled as a delivered message.
Dependencies / gate: Implement reusable templates and checks. Do not depend on an unverified ShiftCare SMS/chat send API.

Current manual work: Communication evidence is scattered and staff must separately establish whether someone was notified or responded.
Proposed n8n coordination: Link authorized references to the person and case. Track approval, dispatch, delivery, response and failed delivery as distinct outcomes, with follow-up ownership.
Retained human step: Resolve unsupported channels and verify actual acknowledgement when required.
Acceptance: Each status is backed by its own evidence, with unknown outcomes and failed delivery kept open.
Dependencies / gate: Agree channel coverage and add permitted Sent Items/failure evidence. A Graph 202 response is not delivery proof; universal cross-channel read receipts are not promised.

Current manual work: Staff copy booking details, clarify times and assess capacity; a free calendar slot may be personal time.
Proposed n8n coordination: Prepare booking drafts and check explicit dates, times, service details, roster overlaps, leave and available capacity evidence.
Retained human step: Confirm suitability, worker willingness, participant agreement and native acceptance.
Acceptance: A reviewed one-off arrangement has a verified native result or an explicit native creation handoff.
Dependencies / gate: Add a whitelisted one-off create adapter and explicit native IDs/defaults if API creation is included. Availability patterns need date expansion; free time is not willingness.

Current manual work: Staff clarify one-visit versus recurring changes and reopen bookings to check whether edits saved.
Proposed n8n coordination: Preview affected occurrences, retain the approved scope and compare saved native fields with the intended change before reporting success.
Retained human step: Approve occurrence/series scope and resolve group or locked bookings.
Acceptance: Only the approved scope changes; native mismatch, stale data and locks leave an owned exception.
Dependencies / gate: Keep initial writes to accepted occurrence scope. Series operations are published but not implemented in the existing adapter.

Pain point / process: Travel checking and stale value detection
Current manual work: Travel distances, durations and blocks need manual checks and can remain outdated after booking or worker changes.
Proposed n8n coordination: Prepare estimates from confirmed addresses, compare travel and service blocks, and flag estimates invalidated by changed workers, locations or preceding visits.
Retained human step: Verify ambiguous addresses and approve actual claims or scheduling decisions.
Acceptance: Changes to worker, address or preceding visit invalidate the estimate; no estimate becomes actual mileage.
Dependencies / gate: Move dependency fingerprints/checks to shared server records. F covers estimates and stale-value checks, not mileage entitlement.

Current manual work: Staff open bookings to copy missing instructions and track revised wording in separate tools.
Proposed n8n coordination: Find missing instructions and preview approved versions for selected bookings. Retain effective dates and change history alongside the intended booking scope.
Retained human step: Approve wording, effective date and affected occurrences.
Acceptance: Selected editable bookings match the approved instructions without changing unrelated fields.
Dependencies / gate: Add a description-only adapter, version/hash checks and read-back. Validate series behaviour and locked/cancelled records before bulk changes.

Current manual work: Staff inspect reminder replies daily and determine which visit and follow-up each response concerns.
Proposed n8n coordination: Match replies to exact occurrences and route confirmations, cancellations, changes, unclear replies and outstanding responses to their appropriate cases.
Retained human step: Resolve sender/occurrence ambiguity and approve any resulting service mutation.
Acceptance: A clear reply routes once; ambiguous replies and silence never trigger automatic cancellation.
Dependencies / gate: Test actual notification formats, mailbox routing, quoted replies and occurrence matching; add event reads if needed.

Current manual work: A worker may be notified while the booking remains active, and travel charges require separate correction.
Proposed n8n coordination: Coordinate the exact occurrence, cause, notice, approved charge treatment, native cancellation, required travel/mileage corrections and participant/worker updates. Verify all required outcomes before closure.
Retained human step: Approve cause, notice, actual travel and financial treatment; review locked or unsupported changes.
Acceptance: No untravelled charge remains incorrectly applied; partial or unknown outcomes stay open without duplicate dispatch.
Dependencies / gate: Add verified cleanup before cancellation where required. Cancelled shifts restrict later edits. Model cleanup-success/cancel-failure and block closure until required handoffs finish.

Current manual work: Sickness and departures trigger urgent reassignment, travel review and individual participant decisions across affected services.
Proposed n8n coordination: List affected bookings, assign cover deadlines, present suitability evidence and track offers, acceptance and each participant's replacement, reschedule or skip decision.
Retained human step: Choose suitable cover and confirm worker acceptance and participant preference.
Acceptance: Each affected service has a verified arrangement or owned no-cover outcome, with required communication.
Dependencies / gate: Add shared cover-case dependencies and affected-service tracking. Keep offer and acceptance native until their adapters are accepted.

Current manual work: Managers search roster and communication records to reconstruct when a worker was absent and which services were affected.
Proposed n8n coordination: Link factual absence dates, affected bookings, source evidence and authorized communication references in a restricted history.
Retained human step: Management resolves disputed facts and all employment interpretation.
Acceptance: A source-linked history is visible only to authorized reviewers; it makes no performance conclusion.
Dependencies / gate: Defer dedicated HR history until core absence coordination is accepted; define restricted access and corrections.

Current manual work: Files must be found across email and storage, matched to the right person and placed in the correct native location.
Proposed n8n coordination: Index original locations, match person/type/version/visibility and prepare supported filing. Link the original to the verified native result or checked filing handoff.
Retained human step: Confirm person, signature/version, category and permitted visibility.
Acceptance: The correct original is verified under the correct native person, category and access setting.
Dependencies / gate: Validate actual document types, field/date formats and download hosts. Do not claim the adapter supports every staff file or image.

Current manual work: Staff inspect records individually for paperwork and follow up emails referring to missing attachments.
Proposed n8n coordination: Compare agreed document requirements with available evidence, identify missing attachments and create owned clarification or filing tasks.
Retained human step: Assess signature, authenticity and documents held outside the visible sources.
Acceptance: Missing, present and unreadable/unknown evidence remain distinct and generate the right follow-up.
Dependencies / gate: Add requirement matrices and complete-scope results. F covers presence/metadata checks, not proof that a valid agreement exists or is absent everywhere.

Current manual work: Plan and agreement dates can be confused, while incorrect metadata makes non-expiring documents appear expired.
Proposed n8n coordination: Present date candidates with original text, distinguish their meaning and prepare evidence-based corrections to native expiry metadata.
Retained human step: Interpret document meaning and approve non-expiring classifications.
Acceptance: Only evidence-backed corrections suppress false alerts; genuine expiries remain visible.
Dependencies / gate: Validate date/null/no-expiration response semantics. General staff-file expiry correction is not implemented in the current adapter.

Current manual work: Genuine renewals and requests for updated dates, funding or supporting documents require repeated external chasing.
Proposed n8n coordination: Schedule scoped checks, assign requests and renewal work, retain responses and track deadlines until required evidence is reviewed.
Retained human step: Verify received documents, funding/date meaning and completion.
Acceptance: A due item creates one owned follow-up, remains open until checked and survives a missed schedule.
Dependencies / gate: Reuse native reminder sending, repair metadata first, avoid duplicate alerts and implement missed-run recovery and escalation.

Current manual work: Staff compare service records individually and resolve coding, travel, tax-setting and unusual-invoice questions.
Proposed n8n coordination: Assemble scheduled/actual time, attendance, notes, agreements and invoice lines into specific exceptions. Check approved category mappings and review cutoffs, reusing native accounting settings.
Retained human step: Bookkeeper approves category, charge, tax and unusual treatment, then uses native export.
Acceptance: Complete period evidence produces traceable exceptions; no duplicate invoice/export or false all-clear occurs.
Dependencies / gate: Add cursor-aware pre-invoice reads and agreed rules/cutoffs. Use native pricing rather than calculating care billing rates in the application.

Current manual work: Advance payments and special arrangements depend on staff memory and scattered notes.
Proposed n8n coordination: Show approved instructions beside the relevant person and verified Xero credit/prepayment references, using stable native record links.
Retained human step: Bookkeeper applies balances and approves accounting treatment.
Acceptance: Current accounting evidence is linked without automatic credit allocation or balance invention.
Dependencies / gate: Defer live balance integration until authorized Xero access and ID reconciliation are implemented. Do not create another ledger.

Current manual work: Plan-manager or payer changes may not reach staff before invoices are issued.
Proposed n8n coordination: Flag changed payer/contact evidence and track verified recipient details, verification dates and linked ShiftCare/Xero identities.
Retained human step: Staff verify authority and effective payer changes before updating billing.
Acceptance: A changed billing recipient has an authorized, effective instruction and verified native identity.
Dependencies / gate: Defer dedicated cross-system recipient automation; keep checks in existing onboarding/billing review until account mappings are verified.

Current manual work: Staff locate rejected invoices, investigate reasons and coordinate corrections across records and conversations.
Proposed n8n coordination: Link the external invoice, rejection, supporting service records, correction history, owner and next action in one case.
Retained human step: Bookkeeper determines credit, correction or reissue and checks the result.
Acceptance: The reason and corrected native outcome are linked without a duplicate invoice.
Dependencies / gate: Defer a dedicated correction/reissue automation; reuse #3/#22 cases and native accounting actions first.

Current manual work: Calls, resending and payment checks require chasing, while unresolved invoices affect owners' cash planning.
Proposed n8n coordination: Use authorized, verified accounting status to prepare overdue/returned invoice tasks, approved contact actions and visible unresolved collection work.
Retained human step: Bookkeeper approves disputes, escalation and any collection action.
Acceptance: Paid invoices stop further chasing and ambiguous/reversed payment states stay reviewable.
Dependencies / gate: Defer custom collection status until ledger IDs, tokens and reconciliation are accepted; do not treat a ShiftCare balance as verified Xero payment.

Current manual work: Staff check run dates, employee lists and carried-over values; inactive workers or unexplained prior values need review.
Proposed n8n coordination: Check the approved period, payment dates and run population. Surface starter/leaver exceptions and compare the confirmed carried-over field with current inputs.
Retained human step: Payroll confirms final-pay eligibility and the meaning of prior values.
Acceptance: Run dates/population reconcile and leavers needing final pay are retained.
Dependencies / gate: Defer payroll-side automation until the actual vendor/field mappings are known. Inactive ShiftCare access does not establish zero pay.

Current manual work: Staff compare workers' hours and mileage with payroll inputs and investigate missing source timesheets.
Proposed n8n coordination: Check source completeness, compare approved values and flag differences. Keep hours, kilometres and currency distinct, reusing the native timesheet transfer where applicable.
Retained human step: Payroll approves payable values and resolves discrepancies before native release.
Acceptance: Missing timesheets never become zero pay; approved quantities and units trace to their source and period.
Dependencies / gate: First deliver source checks and reviewed handoff. Add two-sided comparison only against the real export/API; do not claim automated payroll reconciliation without it.

Current manual work: Adjustments, leave, back pay and first-job travel decisions must be recovered from notes and applied to the right period.
Proposed n8n coordination: Retain affected period, original and corrected values, supporting evidence, calculation reference, approval and explanatory note for each adjustment.
Retained human step: Payroll calculates and approves leave, back pay and travel treatment in the established payroll process.
Acceptance: Each applied adjustment has the correct period, authorization and verified native result.
Dependencies / gate: Keep calculations and native entry manual initially; support evidence through #28 rather than building an award/payroll engine.

Current manual work: Saving, finalizing and delivering payslips requires separate completion steps in the external payroll process.
Proposed n8n coordination: Show unresolved preparation checks and track the checked handoff to the payroll administrator, including references for required completion steps.
Retained human step: Authorized payroll staff finalize the run, release payment and deliver payslips in the payroll platform.
Acceptance: Preparation is handed off with evidence; payroll completion retains its own native approval trail.
Dependencies / gate: Retain finalization and money movement in the established platform; a duplicate release workflow adds little benefit and substantial risk.

Current manual work: Missing notes, reported incomplete work, unusual durations and important events can be buried among routine records.
Proposed n8n coordination: Surface factual attendance, task, note and duration exceptions with original evidence and an assigned supervisor. Restrict sensitive care information.
Retained human step: Supervisors investigate quality, care and employment concerns.
Acceptance: A factual exception cites its original record and owner without making a clinical or misconduct conclusion.
Dependencies / gate: Validate complete periods, staff-specific evidence and restricted access; task-specific completion comparisons need accepted source fields.

Pain point / process: Feedback complaint and safety follow through
Current manual work: Feedback calls, complaint histories, pending responses and safety follow-up require coordination across several sources.
Proposed n8n coordination: Schedule agreed feedback tasks, retain responses and link restricted complaint or hazard evidence to callbacks, decisions, deadlines and resulting actions.
Retained human step: Managers handle safety, complaint outcomes and personnel decisions; urgent procedures remain active.
Acceptance: Every response/action has an accountable outcome; restricted information stays within permitted access.
Dependencies / gate: Add restricted case fields, owners, follow-up schedule and explicit urgent escalation; avoid automatic clinical triage.

Systems: Office work queue / email / VA handover
Current manual work: Unconfirmed times, incomplete steps, routine questions and future plans depend on memory or return to the owners.
Proposed n8n coordination: Maintain owners, next actions, deadlines and required completion steps. Show shared handovers, escalate overdue work and schedule agreed closure decisions and follow-ups.
Retained human step: People perform tasks and management supplies delegated authority and actual coverage.
Acceptance: A parent case cannot close while any mandatory child outcome remains incomplete or uncertain.
Dependencies / gate: Add parent-case dependencies, external notification outcomes and catch-up. Current native jobs can complete before their separate communication follow-up.

Current manual work: Uncovered services, uneven demand, recurring costs and administration pressure complicate operating decisions.
Proposed n8n coordination: Report actual uncovered/cancelled services, enquiry and booking history, unresolved invoices, overdue tasks and processing delays. Measure staff handling and recovery effort alongside operating costs.
Retained human step: Management interprets staffing, cost and demand implications.
Acceptance: Reports state period, source completeness and actual outcomes; they make no unsupported savings or revenue claim.
Dependencies / gate: Keep baseline pilot measures in core instrumentation; defer a dedicated reporting workflow until daily work is stable. No forecast model is proposed.

Pain point / process: Arrival visibility if the remaining gap is confirmed
Current manual work: Participants interrupt the office to ask whether their worker is on the way or delayed.
Proposed n8n coordination: Assess native visibility first. For a demonstrated remaining gap, provide a fresh, consented arrival estimate tied to the current assignment and withdraw stale information.
Retained human step: Approve access/consent and validate actual devices and withdrawal behaviour.
Acceptance: Only permitted current service access sees fresh status; reassignment or stale updates withdraw it.
Dependencies / gate: Defer optional arrival work pending native-feature fit and device/privacy trials; continuous background tracking is not established.
